description: Get workspace details by ID or slug, including the admin-set controls that decide what runs in it may do. `settings` is a ceiling, never a grant: a network policy there applies on top of each worker's own, and a feature switched off there cannot be switched back on per project.

id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Provide this or slug.

slug.description: Workspace URL slug, e.g. "acme" for app.stuntdouble.io/w/acme. Provide this or id.

name: get_workspace

settings.description: Workspace-wide ceilings on what runs may do.

title: Get workspace
